Hi Sofia & Raj,

Thanks again for the call this morning — great to hear more about FintechCo's roadmap and the conversational search use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Procurement setup: FintechCo's AP team prefers POs for purchases > $10k; credit card ok for one-off or smaller pilots.
- Vendor onboarding: there’s a standard vendor form + W9 and a brief security questionnaire to get on the vendor portal/marketplace.
- Commercial path: you mentioned interest in a marketplace listing vs direct procurement; both are options — marketplace may speed onboarding but has different billing cadence.

Next steps I can own:
1) Share a short pricing & cost-breakdown for pilot vs committed capacity (attached).
2) Attach vendor onboarding checklist and vendor forms you can run through with AP.
3) If you want to use a PO, confirm who will issue it and typical lead time (we can accept standard net-30/net-45 terms after vendor onboarding).
4) If marketplace is preferred, we can provide marketplace agreement + steps.

Ask for you: can Raj confirm the PO threshold (you mentioned $10k as a rough number) and whether the marketplace requires any additional vendor paperwork?

I’ve attached the vendor onboarding checklist and a high-level pricing breakdown (card vs PO scenarios). I’ll also loop in Lauren from Finance/Partnerships to help with marketplace/vendor questions.

Available for a quick follow-up tomorrow if helpful.

Best,

From: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@fintechco.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & payment flow (PO vs card) — next steps

Thanks, Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifications from AP and procurement: 

- Confirmed: our AP team requires a formal PO for any vendor spend over $10,000. Smaller pilots under that threshold can go on a corporate card or a single-use virtual card.
- Vendor onboarding: we use a vendor portal (link below) where vendors upload W9, COI, and bank details. We also need someone on your side to fill out a marketplace enrollment form if you want Redwood listed.
- Timing: typical vendor onboarding is 7–10 business days once all docs are submitted. If we go direct (PO) it ties to our normal 30/45 day processing depending on month close.

Questions for you: 
1) Can you confirm what documents Redwood needs to be a vendor? (W9, COI, bank details — will an initial W9 suffice to start?)
2) Is there a minimum contract value or commitment you advise for a pilot to avoid re-onboarding later?
3) If we opt for marketplace, do you support consolidated monthly invoicing or is it per-transaction?

Happy to route any forms to our AP inbox (ap@fintechco.com). I’ll loop in Raj for the PO threshold confirmation.

Best,
Sofia Morales
Head of Partnerships, FintechCo
sofia.morales@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: procurement & payment flow (PO vs card) — next steps

Thanks Sofia — great, that aligns with what we discussed. Quick answers here and proposed plan: 

1) Documents: W9, COI (certificate of insurance), bank ACH details (for net terms) — the W9 is usually sufficient to create the vendor profile initially; COI and ACH can follow but helps speed things to have them up front.
2) Minimum commitment: we don’t require a long-term minimum for a pilot — many customers run a 30–90 day pilot under $10k on card. For pilots that will scale quickly we recommend a 3–6 month committed capacity to lock pricing and ensure performance SLAs.
3) Marketplace billing: we support both per-transaction billing and consolidated monthly invoicing for marketplace customers — happy to match FintechCo’s preference.

Proposed next steps (we can consolidate into a mutual action plan):
- I will send the vendor onboarding checklist + W9 template (attached) and the pricing breakdown (attached).
- If FintechCo issues a PO, please send the PO PDF to ap@redwoodinference.com and cc lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com.
- If you prefer marketplace, reply here and we’ll send the marketplace enrollment + sample consolidated invoice.

I’ll follow up with Lauren to confirm the account setup and invoicing options. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with Raj and your AP team if that helps speed things.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments:
- redwood_vendor_onboarding_checklist.xlsx
- redwood_pricing_breakdown_annual_card_vs_po.pdf
